name: Full Crew
overview: Full cast and crew by department on movie and series pages
description: Fetches complete TMDB cast and crew for movies and series, groups people by department (Cast, Camera, Costume & Make-Up, Sound, Visual Effects, and more), and shows them in a polished accordion on Jellyfin Web item detail pages.

versions.changelog: Initial release: full TMDB cast/crew accordion, JS Injector + File Transformation injection, shared Jellyfin TMDB key fallback.
